endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Prometheus metrics URLs to scrape such as http://localhost:8080/metrics

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: How often each endpoint is scraped such as 15s (at least 1s)

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Extra labels every scraped sample is stored with such as env=dev

allowMutation.title: Allow mutation
allowMutation.description: Allow probes to change runtime settings

seam.title: Seam
seam.description: How the capture is armed (supported seams: [host])

wait.title: Wait for agents
wait.description: Wait for a matching agent to connect

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: How long one scrape may take such as 5s (at most the interval; default the shorter of 10s and the interval)
